From: Sylvia Brown <sylvia.brown@regulatech.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@healthco.com
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Evidence staging request for UK Addendum + onboarding

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the call this morning. HealthCo's legal team has asked us to produce a concise evidence package to support the UK Addendum review — they want an itemised index that maps: SCCs/UK IDTA clauses -> where evidence lives (policy, screenshot, log extract) -> responsible Redwood owner -> estimated delivery date.

High-level asks:
- Mapping spreadsheet (single sheet) showing clause -> evidence item -> link or stub name
- Export of subprocessor list (current, with country of processing and roles)
- Short note on TLS/in-transit encryption and where key custody lives (KMS/HSM)
- Example audit log extract (redacted) for a user deletion request route

Target deadline: Friday 07 Aug EOD (HealthCo is in a compressed procurement window). If we can't deliver everything by then, please indicate what will be late.

Sylvia
Regulatech (on behalf of HealthCo)

Sylvia,

Appreciate the clear list — we'll take this on. Quick plan from our side:
- I'll own the clause -> evidence mapping and produce the single sheet.
- Kimberly will pull the subprocessor export and annotate countries/roles.
- Jordan will draft the short KMS/key custody note and identify the HSM region for the HealthCo tenant.
- Naomi will pull an audit log sample and coordinate redaction.

We should be able to get the first pass (mapping + subprocessor export + KMS note) to you by Thu 06 Aug morning; audit log extract may slip to Fri 07 Aug depending on redaction time. If HealthCo needs everything by Thu EOD, flag that and we'll reprioritise.
